input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 所以他们找到了很多植物对药：来做药
- 神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears；吃了很多植物，了completed
- 但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人：他们吃的植物让他们生病，让Sb. + V./Adj.
- 神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒：可能毒性特别强，”特别是+N, + Clause” is used to single out a typical example
- 所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药：找一个可以做药的植物；这样，他们可以……
- 他想把花放在茶里，对药：做成药

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很多植物对药：很多可以做药的植物，The phrase “对药” cannot describe plants serving as medicine; use “可以做药” as a modifier of “植物”. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 对药：来治病，To express the purpose of eating plants, use “来” followed by an action; “对药” is not a valid purpose phrase here. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他们的吃的植物：他们吃的植物，“他们吃的” is the verb-plus-modifier structure for plants that they eat; “他们的” incorrectly adds a possessive marker. [rule: none]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 让他们病人：让他们生病，“病人” is a noun meaning a sick person, but after “让” the sentence needs a verb phrase; “生病” means to become ill. [rule: none]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 可能特别是毒：可能特别有毒，“毒” cannot be directly modified by “特别”; “有毒” is the correct predicate meaning poisonous. [teacher rule: du_youdu]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个植物：一种植物，Because the sentence refers to a type of plant that can be used as medicine, “种” is the suitable measure word. [rule: none]
7. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 对药：做药，“对药” is not a verb phrase; “做药” expresses using the plant as medicine. [rule: none]
8. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 吃对药：吃药，“对药” does not mean medicine in this context; “吃药” is the correct verb-object phrase. [rule: none]
9. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 对药：做药，“做药” expresses the intended purpose, while “对药” is not grammatical here. [rule: none]
10. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，On a character’s first mention, briefly introduce the person with a full noun phrase rather than using only the name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
11. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这个植物：这些植物，No single plant has been introduced immediately before this sentence; “这些植物” clearly refers back to the many plants the patients ate. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
12. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他们可以吃药：病人可以吃药，The pronoun could refer either to the doctors or to the patients, so repeat the noun for a clear reference. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
13. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 先看到：先看到了，“看到” is a completed action in this sequence, so it takes “了”. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “对药”不能表示植物可以被用来做药，改成“可以做药的植物”正确。
“对药”在这里不是可用的表达；“来治病”本身是正确的目的短语。
修饰“植物”时应说“他们吃的植物”，不应加多余的“他们的”。
“病人”是名词，不能直接作“让”的结果；“让他们生病”正确。
“毒”不能受“特别”修饰，而“特别有毒”是正确的谓语表达。
“一个植物”可以指一株具体的植物，并非必须改为表示种类的“一种植物”。
“对药”不是这里可用的动词短语，“做药”可以表达把植物用作制药材料。
“吃对药”不成立，药物作宾语时应说“吃药”。
“对药”不成立，改为“做药”能表达该花被用来制药。
神农首次出现时需要作简短介绍，“一个叫神农的人”符合该要求。
“这个植物”可以指神农注意到的一株具体植物，原文并不必然要求改成复数。
教师保留了“他们可以……”的说法，因此此处的“他们”不应被判为必须改成“病人”。
“看到”是叙事中完成的动作，应说“先看到了”。
